query: Set up a devcontainer for this project.
files: A Python project with pyproject.toml and no .devcontainer/, and a python template in the capsule store
expected_behavior: Lists the stored templates with `capsule list` and picks the python one
Runs `capsule init python`, so a `.devcontainer/` appears in the project
Does not run `capsule run`, which opens an interactive shell

query: Also mount my SSH keys into every container, read-only.
files: The project from the previous turn, with .devcontainer/ copied from the python template, and a ~/.config/capsule/config.toml that has a [volumes] section
expected_behavior: Adds the SSH mount to the project's .devcontainer/devcontainer.json as a readonly mount, not as a third field in config.toml
Tells the user a read-only mount can't be global, and asks before adding it to stored templates under ~/.config/capsule/
Asks the user before recreating the container, since recreating wipes installed state
Leaves the existing mounts in config.toml unchanged

files: A capsule store with the six shipped templates
expected_behavior: Runs `capsule list` and reports the template names
